## 🚨 EMERGENCY INTAKE SOURCES
Captures incoming disaster reports from Telegram, Gmail, Web Form, or CSV batch.

## 🧠 GROQ AI CLASSIFICATION
Evaluates whether message describes a real/simulated disaster vs casual chat.

## 🔍 GROQ AI EXTRACTION
Extracts disaster type, precise location, affected count, and resource requirements.

## 🔄 DEDUPLICATION & INCIDENT MERGING
Checks active database incidents and merges matching duplicate reports.

## ⚖️ PRIORITY ENGINE & MONGODB
Calculates deterministic priority score (0-100) and persists incident to database.

## 👮 HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP APPROVAL
Critical and High priority incidents require operator review before dispatch.

## 📢 AUTOMATED MULTI-CHANNEL RESPONSE
Dispatches Telegram alert, Email notice, Response Task, and Audit Logs.

## ⏱️ RESPONSE LIVELINESS & INCIDENT MONITORING
Scheduled cron runs every 5 minutes, checks response staleness, and escalates delayed incidents.
